name: io.github.tonyyang0504/pinterest_catalogs-mcp
description: Pinterest Catalogs (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing. Every tool maps to a docum

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, catalogs:read and catalogs:write (apps have trial access until Pinterest grants standard access). Continuous refresh tokens rotate on every refresh: the runtime keeps the new one and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest_catalogs.json (0600).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter country of the catalog items, e.g. US.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of the catalog items, e.g. en-US or EN.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CATALOGS_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO currency appended to prices ('24.99 USD'); required when update_listing sends a price.
